items.html: *And know that while they were back to back, they coupled and ascended above into the bosom of Aba and Ima, and returned there face to face. Then he placed in her the spirit that he leaves in her at the first intercourse, and it is the aspect of a drop of a complete coupling in the Hasadim of NRN — from BaN, MaH, and SaG: AB, AB, AB — the Gematria of Gevura. For each of these is not truly AB, as is known, except when SaG combines with its ten letters, and MaH with 26, and the square of the name HVYH of BaN, which is the AB of BaN.
